We Are Solaris Energy Infrastructure

Founded in 2014, Solaris Energy Infrastructure (NYSE: SEI) delivers proprietary power generation and distribution solutions, as well as logistics equipment and services, to clients in the data center, energy, commercial, and industrial sectors.
We deliver turnkey solutions using industry-leading technologies combined with exceptional service for superior customer performance.
Where You Need It, When You Need It

Solaris delivers reliable technology where and when you need it. We combine deep operational expertise with rapidly deployable, integrated power generation and distribution systems to provide best-in-class uptime and high-quality solutions—maximizing performance.
We leverage deep operational experience to deliver solutions engineered for the unique demands of high-density power workloads.
We accelerate speed to market with power up to utility-scale deployed in weeks, not years.
We deliver high quality power for maximum uptime, seamlessly managing load variability and keeping operations running.
Learn More About the Solaris CREATORS Culture
Solaris delivers innovative, automated systems combined with customer-centric field services and turnkey last mile logistics that optimize the wellsite’s safety, efficiency and execution.

We provide advanced electrical control and distribution rental equipment, along with associated technical design and engineering services, delivering fast-turnaround solutions for complex and critical power systems.

pages.raw_meta: Solaris Power Solutions deliver utility scale, permanent power solutions that gets your site to full power faster. With a low-emissions system and proven performance, we provide a tailored solution for you to safely manage highly variable AI load and secure 99.999% uptime.
raw_blocks: CONTACT US SOLARIS LENS LOGIN
Highly reliable, rapidly deployable power solutions
Engineered for Performance . Delivered with Speed .

Solaris delivers utility-scale power solutions for expediting your energization. With low-emissions systems and proven performance, we provide tailored solutions that enable you to safely manage highly variable power loads with exceptional reliability.
Solaris delivers proven power solutions for the world’s most demanding data center environments.
Large scale deployments across multiple AI clusters—and growing.
Power solutions engineered and deployed at record speed for hyperscaler AI workloads.
Rapidly deployable systems enable fast GPU ramp-up, stable performance, and exceptional uptime.
Engineered for Every Power Need
Our integrated architecture combines technology, expertise, and proprietary software to support continuous, high-density power loads of all sizes.
Power generation and distribution, BESS, and control systems combined into turnkey, custom solutions.
Modular redundancy ensures reliability beyond single-system limits.
Pre-engineered power blocks enable rapid mobilization and seamless expansion.
We deliver high-uptime power with real-time monitoring and dedicated operations, helping you mitigate grid volatility and manage dynamic loads with confidence.
Proprietary software, BESS, power generation and distribution technologies work together to manage fluctuating workloads.
Systems engineered end-to-end for continuous, reliable operation.
Turnkey solutions that can deliver full power significantly faster than traditional utility timelines.
Providing Behind the Meter Power for AI Supercluster
Dedicated Support, Every Step of the Way
With our fully owned operations model, leveraging decades of expertise and industry-leading technologies, we deliver utility scale power tailored to your needs.
We design power infrastructure to match your exact mechanical and IT loads. Every system is built for reliability, scalability, and future growth.
We engineer and deploy quickly to accelerate time to power. Our streamlined processes reduce complexity and get infrastructure online faster.
We own and operate the infrastructure for consistent, reliable performance with preventive maintenance and real-time monitoring to maximize uptime and efficiency.
Power Solutions for What's Next.
Built for today’s demands, ready for tomorrow’s growth.
